families.weak_exchange_large_field: Local fields separate sites energetically while weak exchange suppresses transfer; nonlinear spectral aliases and weak information compete.
families.mixed_sign_disorder: Independent field-sign patterns test multimodal inference beyond globally aligned disorder.
families.near_symmetry: Exact or approximate translation/spin symmetries create spectral degeneracies; diagonalization remains well-defined.
families.strong_frustration: Comparable first- and second-neighbor terms and large anisotropy produce crowded many-body spectra.

selection_rule: Parameter-space sweep fixed without selecting measurement-noise realizations. Repeat each parameter vector twice to distinguish persistent model/design failures from noise outliers.
